commissionRunsSubtitle: Create and process commission + override runs. Identity comes from Pulse — no participant sync.
commissionRunsPhase1Hint: Phase 1 scaffold: upload, validation, and calculation arrive in later phases. Commission and override streams are both in scope.
agenciesSubtitle: Agencies come from Pulse. Choose whether commission statements are issued to each agent or rolled up to the agency.
agenciesSearch: Search by name, NPN, or id…
agenciesSelectHint: Select an agency from the list to configure remittance.
agenciesPayModeDefault: Using the system default until you change it.
agenciesPayModeCustom: Custom pay mode saved for this agency.
agenciesPayModeHelp: Direct: statement per agent. Through agency: one statement for the agency (they distribute externally).
agenciesPayModeIntro: This does not change how amounts are calculated — only who receives the generated statement.
payModeDirectHelp: Each agent under this agency gets their own commission statement.
payModeThroughAgencyHelp: One statement is issued to the agency. They handle distribution outside Pulse.
agenciesEmptyBody: When agencies exist in Pulse Admin, they appear here automatically.
agenciesEmptyFiltered: Try clearing search or status filters.
loginHubHint: Sign in on Pulse — your account hub — then return here automatically.
loginError: Could not sign in. Check your credentials.
noAccessBody: Commission and override management is limited to platform administrators.
ssoMissingToken: Sign-in link was incomplete. Try again from the app switcher.
ssoRateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
ssoAppCheckFailed: Could not verify this browser. Refresh and try again.
ssoAccountDisabled: This account is deactivated and cannot sign in.
appSwitchHandoffFailed: Could not switch apps. Stay here and try again.
gateBody: Manage your account status in Pulse, then return here.
overviewSubtitle: Configure carrier intake by state, model the distribution graph, import statements, and reconcile override spreads.
overviewAttentionFailedRuns: {count, plural, one {# override run failed} other {# override runs failed}}.
overviewAttentionImported: {count, plural, one {# statement is imported and waiting for a calculation} other {# statements are imported and waiting for a calculation}}.
overviewAttentionMissingRates: {count, plural, one {# active carrier has no state rates yet} other {# active carriers have no state rates yet}}.
overviewAttentionNoCarriers: Add a carrier to configure commission and override intake.
overviewKpiCarriersHint: Ready for commission and override intake
overviewKpiRateCoverageHint: {count, plural, one {# state rate configured} other {# state rates configured}}
overviewFlowHint: Carriers and agencies first, then statements and commission runs.
overviewFlowCarriersHint: Commission and override intake per US state.
overviewFlowAgenciesHint: Pulse agencies and statement pay mode (direct vs through agency).
overviewFlowStatementsHint: Import production lines from carriers or FMOs.
overviewFlowCommissionRunsHint: Process commission + override runs end to end.
overviewShortcutsHint: Secondary setup once carriers and agencies are in place.
overviewShortcutCommissionRuns: Create and manage commission + override runs.
overviewShortcutPlans: Bulk override levels, pay routing, and agency override tiers
name: Name
carriersEmptyHint: Create a carrier to start adding state commission and override rates.
carriersNoMatchesHint: Try another search or clear the market filter.
relationshipsSubtitle: Derived from the Admin agency hierarchy (parent agency → child agency, agency → members). Not edited here.
relationshipsEmptyHint: No relationships yet. Sync participants to derive edges from the org tree.
contractTermsSubtitle: Override contract terms written by compensation plans (audit view). Prefer Plans to assign override levels in bulk. Carrier commission is configured under Carriers.
plansSubtitle: Define reusable override-level packages, apply them to many carriers and agencies, and choose how agents are paid. Carrier commission stays on carrier state rates.
plansTiersSubtitle: Named override PMPM levels for the spread ladder (e.g. Agency Override Gold $25). Not commission.
plansTiersEmpty: No override tiers yet. Seed defaults or create one.
plansGroupsSubtitle: Cohorts of agents that share the same writing override level in a plan.
plansEmpty: No plans yet. Use the wizard above.
plansStep1Help: Name the plan and pick which carriers it covers (or leave carriers for apply time).
plansStep2Help: Choose agencies that receive this override package. Optionally include child agencies under them.
plansStep3Help: Map override tiers to agency roots, child agencies, default agents, and optional agent groups. These set contract levels for the override ladder only.
plansStep4Help: Direct = remittance to the agent. Through agency = remittance to the agency (optional retention %). Override spread math is unchanged.
plansStep5Help: Preview how many override contract terms will be created or updated, then apply.
plansLadderSpread: Illustrative upline override spread if writing at the default level: ${spread} PMPM
plansPayModeDirectHint: The check goes to the agent. Agency retention is cleared on their edge.
plansPayModeAgencyHint: The check goes to the agency. Optional retention % is applied on the agency→agent edge.
plansNeedSlots: Add at least one override level slot (root agency or writing agent).
plansNeedCarriers: Select at least one carrier on the plan or at apply time.
plansPreviewSummary: {terms} override terms ({create} new · {update} update) · {agencies} agencies · {agents} agents · {carriers} carriers
plansApplySuccess: Applied: {terms} override terms across {agencies} agencies, {agents} agents, {carriers} carriers.
carrierRatesImportHint: Upload CSV or Excel (.xlsx). Existing carriers are matched by name + 4-digit code (then code, then name) so re-import updates instead of duplicating. Google Sheets: File → Download → CSV/Excel.
carrierRatesImportEmpty: No data rows found in the file.
carrierRatesImportFailed: Could not import the file. Check the template format.
carrierRatesImportDone: Import done: {imported} new, {updated} updated, {created} carriers created, {errors} row errors.
carriersSubtitle: Carriers by market with per-state commission and override intake for the platform owner. Carrier code is a 4-digit number.
statementsSubtitle: Import carrier/FMO statement lines for commission runs.
label: Label
downlineHint: Under the authority of the selected upline.
derivedTypePending: Pick upline and downline to derive type
relationshipInvalidPair: Invalid pair (an agent cannot be upline of an agency).
stateRatesHint: Commission and override the platform-owner / matriz agency receives from this carrier by US state (PMPM, flat $, or percent; percent may exceed 100%). Downline shares are set elsewhere (contract terms).
linesJsonHint: Each line: writingProducerNpn or writingProducerParticipantId, memberMonths, receivedOverrideAmount, carrierRate, productionDate, state, productCode.
deleteCarrierConfirm: This will remove {name} and all of its state rates from active use.
deleteStateRateConfirm: Remove the rate for {state}. You can add it again later.
